reviews.title: Terrible
reviews.text: I like the UI but most of the time this app won’t work, even in very quiet environments it won’t pick a note at all. Waste of money.

reviews.title: Used to be amazing
reviews.text: This used to be the single best tuner in the App Store. Alas, no longer. Now the latency and delays are so high that it's mostly unusable on modern iOS. The lack of any update in 6 years is causing it to show its age. Farewell, Cleartune! We made beautiful music together!

reviews.title: Freezes
reviews.text: It freezes continuously despite deleting it.

reviews.title: FREEZING After latest update
reviews.text: Worked great for months unusable now even after reinstall and double checking microphone permissions WTF?

reviews.title: Never works
reviews.text: This tuner app never works. It’s like the mic is not connected most of the time, cannot pick up any sounds. I can run other tuner apps at the same time and they work fine so it’s not an issue with my iPhone

reviews.title: Never has worked
reviews.text: I have never had Cleartune work consistently since the release of the iPhone 12 and later. Waste of time and you may as well buy a real life guitar tuner rather than these digital/app based, poorly coded bits of trash.

reviews.title: Too bad
reviews.text: Spent $4 for this.  Worked the first day on iphone11, now is frozen.  It’s just a screen shot.

reviews.title: Does not work
reviews.text: This used to be a great tuner but no longer works on any of my IOS devices.

reviews.title: No longer works
reviews.text: This app no longer works. It’s almost 15 years old and hasn’t been updated in 5. Avoid.

reviews.title: Terrible app
reviews.text: Absolutely terrible doesn’t even react when i play a string

reviews.title: Nice but
reviews.text: Nice tuner but difficult to use. It doesn’t follow the note very well as you tune and doesn’t hear low notes at all. Also doesn’t display the hz

reviews.title: Does not work on Mac Book Air
reviews.text: Even though app says it works on Mac Book- the tuner will not pick up the sound of your instrument.
